get_lightfield_rays: generate light field rays from U, V, s, t parameters with configurable aspect ratio and near/far planes
get_epi_rays: generate epipolar rays from U, v, S, t parameters for stereo and multi-view geometry applications
get_rays: compute ray origins and directions from camera directions and camera-to-world transformation matrices
get_ndc_rays: transform rays into normalized device coordinates using focal length, image dimensions, and near plane
two_plane_param: parameterize rays using two-plane intersection for neural light field representation with configurable voxel size
